# Memoire

> A personal commercial control tower for B2B sellers. It follows one customer
> thread from conversation to quote to delivery to cash, so a deal cannot go
> silent without somebody being told. Built for the individual operator who
> answers for their own pipeline, not for a sales team's manager.

Memoire is web software, installable on iOS and Android, at
https://www.memoire-official.com. It costs **$10 per month for one person**
after a **7-day free trial**. The trial takes a card up front and charges when
it ends; cancelling inside the trial costs nothing. **There is no free tier.**

## What it actually does

- **Capture** — paste a messy note, an email thread or a voice-to-text dump. It
  is parsed on the device into an account, an amount, an objection and a next
  action, and filed against the right deal.
- **Today** — opens on the deals going quiet, the promises not kept and the
  money that is late, ranked, each with the reason attached. Nudges are capped
  at five so it does not become a second inbox.
- **Orders** — contract to cash in seven steps, showing how many days each order
  has been standing still.
- **Cash Collection** — receivable aging built from the payment terms already on
  the quote. Nothing is re-entered.
- **Cost Analysis** — goods, freight and duty landed against the sale, in a
  different currency from the sale if that is how the business buys.
- **Business Vault** — accounts, people and deals as one derived map, ranking
  what you do not yet know by what the relationship is worth.
- **Review** — builds a defend / rescue / downgrade brief from what was
  captured, and shares it as a read-only link.
- **Search & Insights** — answers questions about your own history, computed on
  your device.

## What it is not

Three claims are load-bearing and are enforced in the codebase, not just in
marketing copy:

1. **No AI service.** Memoire has no AI provider, no API key and no AI endpoint.
   Capture parses on the device with rules; Search & Insights computes from your
   own records. Nothing you write is sent to a model.
   (`scripts/verify-no-ai-dependency.mjs` fails the build if this stops being
   true.)
2. **No CRM writeback, ever.** It does not sync to, or write into, Salesforce,
   HubSpot or any other system of record.
3. **No free tier.** An earlier version of this page advertised one; it declared
   limits no code enforced, and it was removed rather than built.

It is also not accounting software, not payroll, not inventory, not ecommerce,
and not a company system of record with a manager dashboard. Teams needing SSO
and an admin console today are not served yet.

## Who it is for

- B2B sellers who own their own follow-up and answer for their own pipeline.
- Founder-led sellers, consultants and agency owners, where selling is a third
  of the week.
- Trading, distribution and supply businesses — where the sale is half the job
  and the cash is downstream of the win.
- Long-cycle deals with procurement and a buying committee.

## Data and privacy

The workspace syncs to cloud storage under your own account, and the app says
so inside when it is running on local fallback instead. Data is not shared
between users. Everything is exportable at any time, and deleting the account
deletes it.
